scope: Independent candidate probe connections on the existing VPS/database; not a deployment or SLO claim

initialComparison.decision: Do not shorten the connection timeout to two seconds

rejectedStartupTimeoutOnly.decision: Pooler startup parameters do not establish the timeout; require explicit SET LOCAL

driverCompatibility.cause: Diagnostic assumed one array per SQL command; postgres.js groups BEGIN/SET and SELECT/COMMIT into two Result arrays
driverCompatibility.decision: Validate the actual two-result protocol shape; do not treat a malformed result as success

explicitTransactionBatch.sql: BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '2500ms'; SELECT 1 AS ready; COMMIT

limitations: Timing observations are individual measurements, not benchmarks or guaranteed latency
A real connection stall or database outage still fails the unchanged three-second readiness deadline
The independent probe does not test business-pool saturation
The deployed application is unchanged by these diagnostics
